data.long_meaning: The name Adnaan is derived from the Arabic root 'dn', meaning 'to serve'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the servant's role in the divine plan and ultimate goal – to serve and worship Allah. The name Adnaan carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adnaan usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
